interpretation: Source-backed discovery observations are not verified game parties, complete office histories or permission to create portraits. Reporting years do not establish organization lifespans. Unknown representation is not absence.

coverage.interpretation: 31 organization observations are not 31 distinct parties: 29 election-funding labels, one later registration decision and one separate PMB naming record. The reviewed HTML funding table is historical election data, not a time-frozen registry as of the research cutoff. The June 2024 aggregate announcement does not date the later release rows.
unresolved: No full Brazilian organization census or leadership timeline from 1990 through 7 September 2026 has been established.
Reconcile FEFC labels and exact process references with dated legal identities, complete names, extinct organizations, splits, mergers and name changes.
The current live registry was not used to backdate leaders or party names. A pre-cutoff archived registry snapshot remains to be obtained.
PCB and PMB release cells are dashes: no date, refusal, nonpayment, inactivity or exclusion is inferred.
The PMB article and initial notice use different names; retain the later explicit rectification and research underlying decisions before creating lifecycle intervals.
Federations, informal parties, parties in formation and institutions are outside this bounded intake; absence here does not establish nonexistence.
All game mappings, leadership roles, continuous lifecycle intervals, successor eligibility and portrait permissions remain unknown.

coverage.scope: 635 unique CNCCFP identifiers in the pinned exercise-2024 filing-obligation publication: 575 in the submitted-accounts CSV and 60 additional AD entries. This financial universe is enumerated; the country political-organization and leadership census is not complete.
unresolved: The 2024 financial-obligation universe is now enumerated, but it is not a register of every French political organization in 1990–2026.
Earlier and later organization histories, non-reporting organizations, independent factions and coalition membership remain unenumerated.
No automatic match to the five existing simulation party rows or their historical components; an empty mapping means unreconciled, not unrepresented.
Overseas/local reporting identities need explicit territorial and campaign-jurisdiction review.
No chair, executive, lifespan, succession, cartoon likeness or 2035 continuation has been inferred from accounts.
Twelve shared CNCCFP codes have differing names or character encodings across the two pinned sources; exact rename dates and the causes of differences remain unverified.
AD does not prove an organization dissolved, stopped political activity, or remained non-compliant after this publication; later appeals and filings require dated evidence.

coverage.interpretation: These are recognition observations, not deduplicated organizations. Repeated names in different jurisdictions remain separate pending identity reconciliation. The March 2024 source tables are preserved with their qualifications; later notifications are not consolidated here.
unresolved: No complete organization census for India from 1990 through 7 September 2026 has been established.
Registered unrecognized parties, delisted/inactive records, alliances, informal organizations and institutions remain outside this bounded intake.
Reconcile repeated names across states, name changes, splits and mergers against primary identity evidence. No deduplicated party total is asserted.
National and state recognition can change; inspect subsequent notifications before claiming status on any later date.
Preserve frozen-name and pending-court-order qualifications; no inferred successor or resolution is granted.
Research separately dated party leaders, chairs, parliamentary roles and executive offices before adding characters or portraits.
All game mappings, lifecycle intervals and leadership terms remain unknown. Fictional successor eligibility and portrait reuse rights have not been researched.

bounded_registers.excluded: Not a nationwide historical party census; constituency-only and local organizations are outside this table.
The independent-member aggregate, vacancies and totals are not organization identities.

unresolved: This packet contains two bounded official lists, not all Japanese political organizations from 1990 to the cutoff. All country-census and art-completion gates remain open.

The 16 election-list entities are explicitly party-or-other-political-organization identities. Statutory qualification, exact legal registration and relationships to similarly named earlier entities remain unverified.
The seven lower-house groups are kept as parliamentary institutions, separate from party identities. Constituent links and all game-party mappings remain empty and unknown.

Japan has constituency-only parties, local/regional organizations, historical mergers, dissolutions and successors outside these observations; a complete official register and historical chronology remain required.

Only four independently titled party offices and five dated holder observations across three organizations were reviewed. These are not full office terms, biography records, campaign eligibility or portrait authorization.
Election candidates and independent-member aggregates are not silently promoted into party leaders or fabricated organizations.

The live upper-house English strength page was dated 13 September 2026 when accessed and was excluded because it exceeds the fixed 7 September cutoff. Search-cache dates were not substituted for the current page.
Neither the 2025 election nor the February 2026 group list establishes a complete present-day September roster. No observations after the cutoff or fictional successors are populated here.

bounded_registers.excluded: Rejected or withdrawn lists, parties outside the federal ballot, regional organizations and other years are outside this resolution appendix.
Factions are parliamentary institutions, not five additional political parties or a census of all Russian parties.

unresolved: Fourteen ballot-list observations and five distinct faction institutions do not establish all Russian political organizations from 1990 through the fixed cutoff.
The official CEC bulletin pages 1, 144 and 145 were downloaded and visually reviewed. The resolution date is 16 August 2021; the exact bulletin publication day is not established.
The historical Duma body was retrieved via search index because direct official-host fetches timed out. Original response verification remains open; current hover biographies were not used.
Five parliamentary leader observations are not party-leader histories. Complete terms, national-executive offices, biographical identities and any portrait permission remain unresolved.
The five faction memberships are reported as 324, 57, 28, 23 and 15. They are preserved without forcing a chamber-capacity total or treating them as party election results.
All game-party mappings and faction constituent links remain empty. Shared names do not create an automatic legal identity match.
Russia and USSR organizations, predecessor states, renames, mergers, dissolutions and regional party histories require separate sourced reconciliation; no continuity is assumed.
This packet does not establish a September 2026 current roster, complete country census, succession eligibility or artwork completion. No post-cutoff facts or fictional successors are populated.

CLAUDE-C01-05 adds one institution, ru_rsfsr_presidency, from RSFSR acts of 1991. It is filed here because Law 2094-I renamed the RSFSR the Russian Federation; it is not mapped from, and does not continue, the USSR Presidency in ussr.json.

The RSFSR Supreme Soviet, its Chairman and the RSFSR Congress of People's Deputies are not institutions in this packet. Yeltsin's 1991 signatures as Supreme Soviet Chairman and his release from that post on 10 July 1991 are recorded as claims only.
No exhaustive primary register of political organizations throughout 1990–2026 was located. This packet does not claim that Saudi Arabia has no political organizations.

Six documented organization identities are distinct in kind: one self-declared party, one historical opposition organization, and four human-rights organizations. They must not all become electoral party rows.
The current game has no Saudi party rows; empty represented_party_ids means no binding, not proof of historical absence or permission to collapse institutions into a fictional party.
Six institutional records are a bounded starting inventory, not all royal, religious, judicial, regional, administrative or advisory bodies.
Legal registration, permitted activity, actual political influence and executive eligibility remain separate unresolved questions; no blanket legal prohibition is inferred from the documents read.

Arabic originals, exact commencement dates, consolidated amendments and complete named role histories still require review. Undated current website office holders were deliberately not bound to the pre-cutoff roster.

No 2026 continuity is inferred solely from older appointments. No candidate, fictional successor, likeness or completed avatar is certified here; post-cutoff fiction remains under the separate policy.

unresolved: A closed 2024 National Ballot result universe is not the full national, regional, provincial, local, deregistered, historical or non-contesting party universe from 1990 through the cutoff.
Review earlier and later official registers, excluded electoral universes, independent representation and all organizational continuity before claiming a country census.
Reconcile every party with game identities and separately source leadership terms, roles, biographies and portrait permission. No game roster or character eligibility is changed.

Names containing Alliance, Congress or Movement are retained exactly as electoral reporting names. Organizational form, coalition membership, caucus identity and underlying component parties remain unresolved.
DA offices have dated observations only; their relationships and continuity require further evidence. Presidency election does not establish party leadership or inauguration.
No exhaustive primary list of every political organization active, minor, historical or dissolved during 1990–2026 has been established.
These four provisional organization identities and five institutions are research entries only; all represented_party_ids remain empty because the current Tonga game catalog has no party rows.
The ambiguous additional 'Democratic party' label in IPU 2010 remains unresolved and uncounted; the independently observed People's Party is not an identification of that label.
Full leader/chair/parliamentary-role intervals, constitutional effective dates and 1990 opening office holders still require source-by-source verification.
The last verified observations are not automatic extensions to the 7 September 2026 cutoff; unknown gaps remain unknown.

No future candidate, fictional successor, portrait likeness or avatar completion is certified by this research packet. Fiction begins only after the preserved historical cutoff under the separate policy.

The added 2021 People's Party and Leader observations close only a missing sourced observation. No country census or discovery batch is complete; the 2019 national appointment supplies no party office or campaign eligibility.

Reconciliation packet 01 (tonga-reconciliation-01.md) groups the PATOA/PTOA label with DPFI and adds People's Party names, incorporated-society testimony and a 2021 Assembly selection. It resolves no complete leadership term, lifespan or game mapping.

Transition packet 02 (tonga-transition-2021-02.md) adds the 2021 Assembly procedure notices, the royal appointment of Siaosi Sovaleni effective 27 December 2021 and the Cabinet effective 28 December 2021, with two holder observations. The warrant's signature and presentation and the end of the previous premiership remain unresolved; no complete leadership term is claimed.
This is a bounded 1990-1991 source inventory: one party and three state institutions, not an exhaustive USSR party, faction, opposition, republic or coalition census.

The packet does not establish absence of other organizations. Discover original party registers, congresses, candidate organizations and opposition movements with separate union/republic jurisdiction.
Exact party election dates, acting roles, original spelling and full leadership intervals remain unresolved; contemporary Japanese diplomatic reporting is not an original CPSU election protocol.
1991 office changes, emergency claims, resignations, suspensions and dissolution require their own source review. No legal or organizational continuity through 2026 is inferred.
The USSR packet remains separate from Russia. Existing game party mappings, historical avatar eligibility, likeness approval and post-cutoff fictional succession are not changed.

CLAUDE-C01-05 reviews only the December 1991 records bearing on the Presidency (SURU-TR91-04 to 08). The August 1991 events, the CPSU suspension and the September 1991 changes to the Congress and Supreme Soviet remain unreviewed.
